# GENERATED by TestReachableEmissionArtifactIsRegenerated. DO NOT EDIT BY
# HAND: the test regenerates this file and fails on any difference.
#
# THE CLOSURE RULE. A provider's emitted-field set is the union of the
# resolved field-key writes over the least fixed point of (1) the provider
# type's own methods and (2) for every reached function, every callee that
# resolves to a package-local function whose BODY THIS WALK CAN INSPECT.
# Everything else is a LEAK, and every leak is counted.
#
# Writes are matched by TYPE, so a local, a parameter, a struct field and a
# returned map are one case rather than four.
#
# EVERY CALL SITE IS CLASSIFIED into exactly one disposition, and that
# totality is asserted rather than assumed:
#   followed            an edge taken into a package-local body
#   accounted           a closure literal whose body is walked lexically, so
#                       its writes are already recorded and no edge is needed
#   not_a_call          a type conversion, which merely parses as a call
#   excluded_by_design  a function in another package, or a builtin
#   leaked              everything else -- see the per-cause breakdown
#
# WHAT A LEAK MEANS. A field written behind a leaked call is INVISIBLE to
# this walk. The count is the honest measure of how much of a provider was
# not seen -- not a defect list, and not a promise that the rest is
# complete. An interface method is a leak even when exactly one local
# implementation exists: a single-implementation shortcut is a guess that
# goes quietly wrong the day a second one lands.
#
# dynamic_key_sites counts writes whose KEY is not statically determined,
# plus every `delete` from a fact-field map -- a delete makes the recorded
# set an OVERSTATEMENT rather than an understatement.
#
# A zero in any counter is an OBSERVED zero: every closed token is printed
# on every provider, so a tier nothing reached is visibly empty rather than
# absent. reached_funcs is the walk reporting its own coverage, so a
# collapse shows up here and not as a provider that quietly emits less.
#
# This header claims what the disposition vocabulary proves and nothing
# more. Two earlier versions overclaimed -- one said the walk follows every
# package-local function, one said interface methods are counted while the
# code silently dropped them -- and each was found by a review round. A
# coverage claim that overclaims is itself a defect.
